Acceptance criteria verification (all 4 met):

1. Backend server is initialized and runs locally - src/index.ts creates Express app, listens on PORT env (default 3000), skips listening when NODE_ENV=test; verified via unit tests creating app successfully

2. Minimal API surface is exposed (3 endpoints) - POST /api/v1/connections/test (test connection), POST /api/read-schema (read schema), POST /api/apply-schema (apply schema) in src/app.ts configureApp(); verified via unit + integration tests
3. Server is configurable for local development - backend/.env.example documents PORT=3000 and NODE_ENV=development; src/index.ts reads PORT from env; NODE_ENV=test disables listening for Vitest
4. Open-source technology stack is used - Express (MIT), pg/node-postgres (MIT), zod (MIT), helmet (MIT), cors (MIT) per backend/package.json dependencies
